leagues.name: Anchorage Lacrosse — Flex-6 Summer League
leagues.notes: Non-contact Flex-6 format; weekly Mon/Wed evening games at Arctic Rec Center; teams practice then play vs. opponent; registration via Anchorage Hockey Association SportsEngine; director Gabe Lipchik

leagues.name: FLAX (Fairbanks Lacrosse) — Fall Mini-Season
leagues.governingBody: USA Lacrosse / Fairbanks Youth Soccer Association
